$comment: Reference viewpoints. Every phase ends with a full run of these and a human look at the PNGs. Positions are world metres; y is up. timeOfDay is 24h decimal.

viewpoints.name: valley-dawn
viewpoints.note: Low sun through valley fog. Tests aerial perspective, god rays, volumetric fog, warm/cool separation.

viewpoints.name: mountain-noon
viewpoints.note: High-altitude overlook. Tests ridge silhouettes, snowline, texture tiling at distance, LOD continuity.

viewpoints.name: forest-interior
viewpoints.note: Inside the canopy. Tests grass density, tree LOD0, dappled light, GI in shade, contact shadows.

viewpoints.name: lake-shore
viewpoints.note: Water's edge. Tests absorption gradient, caustics, shoreline foam, reflections, soft depth edge.

viewpoints.name: night-clear
viewpoints.note: Moonlit. Tests Purkinje shift, star field, exposure floor, that night reads as night not blue day.

viewpoints.name: storm
viewpoints.note: Rain and wind. Tests wet materials, puddles, rain particles, wind bend, desaturated grade.
